protocol.selection: Lowest mean of W02 and W03 MAE, equal session weights; persistence wins exact ties. No refit.
protocol.limitations: Validation is later time in the SAME C1 cycle, not independent cycle validation. W04/W05 jointly test transfer to C2, not two independent cycles. Previous absolute-model results on W05 were already observed. No new untouched prospective cycle exists.
protocol.target: soil_future - soil_current; reconstruct current + delta then clip to [0,100]
protocol.paired_rows: Both feature sets use common eligible windows; complete 16-minute history and no watering/missing measurements through forecast horizon.
protocol.saturation: Retain raw ADC 4095 as censored readings; report exclusion sensitivity, no lux conversion.

quality.scope: Only complete dry history and futures with no additional watering
